# NonCardNonCharacterArtPromptLibrary.generated

These generated PNG placeholders follow the local project Markdown art direction: low-saturation retro pixel art, old computer / CRT surveillance dashboard, Chinese student-life slice-of-life scenes, no readable text, no logo, no characters as primary subjects.

## Base Prompt

Pixel art asset for a non-commercial fan-made student growth simulation game, retro surveillance computer interface aesthetic, low-saturation muted green amber gray palette, old monitor frame, CRT scanlines, Chinese school life theme, fixed observation-window composition, no readable text, no logo, no copied commercial UI, no photorealism.
